headline: Canva Case: How to Carry Out a Dignified Dismissal?
summary: Canva drew attention for how it laid off thousands of staff. The column argues that a dignified dismissal goes beyond financial compensation to how employees are treated.
why: Canva is an Australian design software company with a global user base. Large layoffs at high-profile technology firms are closely watched for their effect on costs and workforce planning.
original_headline: Caso Canva: ¿cómo hacer un despido digno?
